description: Header file defining the 'Service' class within the 'Thunder::PluginHost' namespace. It declares a service interface for plugins, including configuration management, web server integration, notification handling, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a plugin service with configuration, web server, notification, and metadata functionalities within the Thunder plugin host framework.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration details for a Service instance, including paths, supported versions, and plugin-specific settings.

methods.name: Versions
methods.description: Returns the supported versions of the plugin as a string.

methods.name: Locator
methods.description: Returns the locator string from the plugin configuration.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the plugin.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign identifier of the plugin.

methods.name: WebPrefix
methods.description: Returns the web prefix URL segment for the plugin.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration line as a string.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Sets a new configuration line for the plugin.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Returns the volatile storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Returns the data storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Returns the system root path associated with the plugin.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Sets the system root path for the plugin.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the plugin service.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Returns whether the plugin is resumed.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Sets the resumed state of the plugin.

methods.name: StartMode
methods.description: Returns the start mode of the plugin.

methods.name: StartMode
methods.description: Sets the start mode of the plugin.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given version number is supported.

methods.name: EnableWebServer
methods.description: Configures the web server URL segment and root path for serving files.

methods.name: DisableWebServer
methods.description: Disables the web server hosting for the plugin.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Returns the plugin's configuration object.

methods.name: StartupOrder
methods.description: Returns the startup order priority of the plugin.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is currently active.

methods.name: IsHibernated
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is hibernated.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Indicates if the plugin has an error message.

methods.name: ErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the current error message.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Fills a Metadata::Service object with current metadata.

methods.name: IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request segment is for the web server.

methods.name: Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to subscribers.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Processes inbound requests, returning a JSON element.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a channel to notifications.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a channel from notifications.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the service for thread safety.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the service.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Sets the current state of the service.

methods.name: ErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the error message for the service.

methods.name: FileToServe
methods.description: Serves a file over HTTP response, considering unsafe paths.
